SELECT
bp.id, bp.package_name, bp.package_description, bp.package_price, bp.package_image_url, bp.status, bp.create_date, bp.update_date, bp.del_flag, bp.version,
bpp.id as bpp_id, bpp.product_id as bpp_product_id, bpp.package_id as bpp_package_id, bpp.quantity as bpp_quantity, bpp.create_date as bpp_create_date, bpp.update_date as bpp_update_date, bpp.del_flag as bpp_del_flag, bpp.version as bpp_version,
bpr.id as bpr_id, bpr.name as bpr_name, bpr.description as bpr_description, bpr.category_id as bpr_category_id, bpr.image_url as bpr_image_url, bpr.has_sku as bpr_has_sku, bpr.base_price as bpr_base_price, bpr.base_stock as bpr_base_stock, bpr.status as bpr_status, bpr.create_date as bpr_create_date, bpr.update_date as bpr_update_date, bpr.del_flag as bpr_del_flag, bpr.version as bpr_version,
bsc.id as bsc_id, bsc.product_id as bsc_product_id, bsc.category_name as bsc_category_name, bsc.create_date as bsc_create_date, bsc.update_date as bsc_update_date, bsc.del_flag as bsc_del_flag, bsc.version as bsc_version,
bs.id as bs_id, bs.category_id as bs_category_id, bs.sku_name as bs_sku_name, bs.sku_description as bs_sku_description, bs.sku_store as bs_sku_store, bs.sku_price as bs_sku_price, bs.create_date as bs_create_date, bs.update_date as bs_update_date, bs.del_flag as bs_del_flag, bs.version as bs_version,
pck_bs.id as pck_bs_id, pck_bs.category_id as pck_bs_category_id, pck_bs.sku_name as pck_bs_sku_name, pck_bs.sku_description as pck_bs_sku_description, pck_bs.sku_store as pck_bs_sku_store, pck_bs.sku_price as pck_bs_sku_price, pck_bs.create_date as pck_bs_create_date, pck_bs.update_date as pck_bs_update_date, pck_bs.del_flag as pck_bs_del_flag, pck_bs.version as pck_bs_version
FROM bar.bar_package bp INNER JOIN bar.bar_package_product bpp ON bp.id = bpp.package_id AND bpp.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN bar.bar_product bpr ON bpr.id = bpp.product_id AND bpr.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN bar.bar_package_sku_bind bpsb ON bp.id = bpsb.package_id AND bpp.product_id = bpsb.product_id LEFT JOIN bar.bar_sku_category bsc ON bsc.id = bpsb.sku_category_id AND bsc.product_id = bpr.id AND bsc.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN bar.bar_sku pck_bs ON pck_bs.id = bpsb.sku_id and pck_bs.category_id = bsc.id AND pck_bs.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN bar.bar_sku bs ON bs.category_id = bsc.id AND bs.del_flag = '0'
bp.del_flag = '0'
AND bp.package_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.packageName}, '%')
AND bp.status = #{condition.status}
AND bp.id = #{condition.packageId}
ORDER BY bp.id, bpp.id, bsc.id, bs.id
